messages:
sara: Heads-up team — planned cutoff for v0.23.1 is in ~4h (today 16:00 PT). Quick checklist: merge version-bump PR, merge changelog, QA smoke + canary, security signoff, docs update. Changlog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/412. Please reply with +1 or a blocker.
ian: QA quick update — smoke on staging green, but a regression on batching was observed in load test (latency spike). I have a reproducer and a fix in a branch, will try to get a patch up in 45m.
sophia: Security run: dependency scan shows one low-sev in test-only dep, not a blocker. I also did a quick secret-scan; nothing leaked. Filing follow-up ticket for dependency upgrade.
luke: Docs: small API wording tweak in docs PR #87, needs one more review. If anyone on this thread can glance, should be <30m.
maya: Version bump PR is #415 — CI is running. @luke can you confirm docs PR doesn't change openapi outputs? If not, we'll merge both.
deploy-bot: build 1024 passed; canary rollout to us-west started.
ian: @maya fyi the batching regression fix will alter the input validation slightly; I can add a test to avoid doc churn, but it might affect the version bump if we cut now.
eli: I'll be on-call during cut and can run rollback if smoke fails. Also can help coordinate merges during the window.
maya: pinging @maintainers for a quick review on #87 and #415 — we need both merged to cut.
sara: If the fix for batching is small and we can get patch merged to release branch, we can still cut. If not, we should delay by 30m. Thoughts?
ian: Patch is small (one-liner guard + test). I can get it merged to release branch in ~25m if CI cooperates.
luke: I reviewed docs change — it doesn't change schema outputs. +1 from docs side.
sophia: Security +1.
maya: CI flaky job on #415 is currently rerunning; ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: smoke tests (canary) reported failures on 3/4 nodes: ERROR: KVCache timeout at step apply_kv (stacktrace truncated). Full logs: ```ERROR: KVCache timeout after 3000ms\n  at inference/runtime/cache.py:122\n  at ...``` — tagging eng-runtime.
ian: That's the same KVCache issue we've seen earlier in stress runs. My patch also includes a backoff for KV calls. I'll prioritize the cherry-pick to release branch.
sara: Okay — plan: delay cutoff by 30m. New cutoff 16:30 PT. @maya keep an eye on CI and deploy-bot for canary smoke. @ian prioritize cherry-pick and testing. @eli be ready for rollback steps.
maya: Acknowledged — updating release calendar and calling out delay in the release notes.
ian: Patch cherry-picked and CI passing on release branch, changelog PR rebased. @sara ready for final merge from QA side.
maya: #415 merged; #87 merged; changelog PR #412 is updated to include batching fix note.
sara: All signoffs in thread: QA, Security, Docs, Version bump merged. Proceeding with cut at 16:30 PT. Thanks everyone :tada:
deploy-bot: release v0.23.1 tag created and cut at 2023-05-15T23:30:12Z. Canary rollout started.
eli: Monitoring metrics and smoke now. Will post if anything looks off.
maya: will run final checklist and close release ticket once canary is healthy.
ian: quick follow-up: filed issue #508 for longer-term KVCache metrics and mitigation work.
sara: Closing thread here — postmortem if any canary problems surface. Great coordination, team.
